name: Ink beneath the water
source:
As a palace maid, you've learnt a secret, one that could have been worth a lot of money... If only it didn't result into you getting pushed down a well to keep it safe.

Heaven still has eyes, as you are not dead (yet).

However, you're not alone in this well... and you're not the only thing that's trying to get out of it.

Darkness lurks beneath the water, but the moon still shines, impassive to it all. 

In the end, in this merciless palace, who can say they've still kept a pure heart?

[From [url=https://arghbulous.itch.io/ink-beneath-the-water]itch.io[/url]]
